Name: Wallpaper and Flooring Collection Volume One
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[b]Sweetpea’s Interiors Catalogue Volume 1[/b]

A placeable catalogue containing 149 wallpapers and 196 floors from six of my previously released interior collections. I made this because my wallpaper and flooring collection becomes absolutely enormous and I did not want hundreds of custom interiors cluttering Stardew Valley’s standard Catalogue nor the mods folder, because obviously I plan on making more so its better if we do it this way.

Sold at Robin’s Carpenter Shop
[heading]Included Collections[/heading]
This catalogue combines the wallpaper and flooring content from these packs, so make sure you remove the older files you have from your mods folder.

[list]
[*]149 wallpapers[/*]
[*]196 floors[/*]
[*]20 rugs[/*]
[*]48 wall panels, including all 40 Canto del Sol panels[/*]
[/list]

[left][b]Requirements
[/b][/left]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/b][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer[/b][/*]
[*][b]Custom Catalogues and Dressers 1.0.1 or newer by pheaux[/b][/*]
[/list][left][/left]
